description: List open jobs at companies on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable or SmartRecruiters from a careers URL or "ats:slug" (for example "greenhouse:airbnb"). Use when the user asks who is hiring, what roles a company has open, or to find remote or engineering roles at a named company. Optional filters: keyword, location, remote, department, postedSince, withSalary. Returns normalized jobs (title, department, locations with ISO country codes, remote, workplace type, compensation, description, apply URL, dates); a board that cannot be read comes back as a type "error" record.

companies.description: Careers page URLs or "ats:slug" tokens, e.g. ["greenhouse:airbnb", "https://jobs.lever.co/spotify"]

department.description: Keep jobs in a department matching this text

keyword.description: Keep jobs whose title or description mentions this text

location.description: Keep jobs whose location text or city contains this, or whose country matches this name or ISO code

maxJobsPerCompany.description: Cap on jobs returned per company after filtering (default 1000)

postedSince.description: ISO date; keep jobs posted or updated on or after it

remote.description: Keep only remote jobs when true

withSalary.description: Keep only jobs that publish a salary figure when true

name: list_jobs
